0.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_CARDTOURNAMENT_000
0.description: Welcome to Card Square, a hallowed battlefield for Triple Triad devotees from across the realm. Speak with the Triple Triad master in the heart of this sanctum, and she will gladly introduce you to the rules of the game!

1.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_CARDTOURNAMENT_001
1.description: Welcome to Card Square! If you find our standard tourneys a shade too overwhelming, then an Open tournament might be just the thing for you!

4.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_Q1_000
4.description: Sign up for an Open tournament.

8.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_SYSTEM_005
8.description: With the exception of Draft, the current tournament has no advanced rules in play. All that is required to enjoy these matches is an understanding of the basic Triple Triad rules.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Sign up for this tournament?

10.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_CARDTOURNAMENT_006
10.description: My apologies, <hex:020810E905FF076D6164616D65FF0473697203>, but we are no longer taking entries for the current tournament. If you would be so kind as to await the next available registration period...?

11.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_CARDTOURNAMENT_007
11.description: I'm terribly sorry, <hex:020810E905FF076D6164616D65FF0473697203>, but the next Open tournament is not quite due to begin.

12.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_CARDTOURNAMENT_008
12.description: You are more than welcome to peruse the schedule should you wish to come back and register at a later time!

13.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_CARDTOURNAMENT_009
13.description: Tournament participants receive rewards based upon their final standing, so might I suggest you organize your belongings before signing up? You wouldn't want your hard-won prize getting crushed in the bottom of your bag!

14.name: TEXT_CMNGSCTRIPLETRIADLTDTOURNAMENT_00703_SYSTEM_010
14.description: Unable to register for tournament. Insufficient inventory space.
